name: Martin Rakhmanov
biography: Martin is a Senior Security Engineer at Amazon Web Services (AWS) RDS Red Team. Prior to that, Martin spent 17 years doing security research of databases and other targets, including servers, desktop applications and hardware. Martin found more than 30 CVEs across various databases and other products.
